brief.en: Spawns new Spore-shrooms from defeated zombies
brief.zh: 使僵尸被击败时能产生新的孢子菇

description.en: Spore-shrooms fire spores that make zombies create new Spore-shrooms when defeated.
description.zh: 孢子菇向僵尸发射能使僵尸被击败时产生孢子菇的子弹。

chat.en: "My favorite arithmetic operation?" wonders Spore-shroom. "I guess I'd have to say, um, addition. Hang on, no... multiplication."
chat.zh: “我最喜欢的算术方式？”孢子菇想。“我猜应该是，嗯，加法！等等，不……是乘法。”
